title: Symbolic vs. Substantive Support: The Impact of Black Lives Matter on Black-Owned Businesses
eligible_reason: Single adoption date. Every regression is reghdfe <outcome> c.black##c.treated, absorb(businessid zipcode#week) cluster(businessid), where black is a time-invariant Black-owned-business indicator and treated is a post-period indicator for weeks after the murder of George Floyd (one common event date, 8-week and 3-week symmetric windows). Figure 4 is the corresponding week-by-week event study (black##ib7.week). With a single switch-on date for all treated units the design fails the at-least-two-adoption-dates rule. The package also ships only synthetic/perturbed data.
design_notes: Business-week panel of Yelp businesses (reviews, ratings, SafeGraph foot traffic, spend). Treatment group: Black-owned businesses (black==1); post indicator treated (also called post). FE: businessid + zipcode#week; cluster businessid. Table 2: four outcomes x two windows (8-week, 3-week) plus standardized versions; Table 3: not-recommended / TOS-removed reviews; Figures 5-6: specification curves over distance cutoffs (reghdfe and ppmlhdfe with black_treated black treated); Figure 7: city-specific effects; Figure 8: by Democratic-lean bins; Figure 9: reviews by reviewer race.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: One event date (late May 2020) for all Black-owned businesses.

specs.exclusion_reason: single adoption date (George Floyd murder); synthetic data
specs.outcome: numreviews (also avgrating, weeklyspend, weeklyfootfall in columns 2-4; standardized versions in table2.2)
specs.treatment_definition: black = Black-owned business (time-invariant); treated = week after the event
specs.sample_condition: 8-week window (regressionDataCombined8Weeks.dta); columns 5-8 use the 3-week window file

data_files_note: _readme.txt: 'proprietary data have been masked or substituted with synthetic data as needed... tables and figures may not exactly replicate original values since key variables have been perturbed to protect firm identities.' Folder is named synth_data.
software_notes: Stata 16+ (reghdfe, ppmlhdfe, outreg2, coefplot, speccurve, grc1leg).
priority_note: Not eligible (single event date) and data are synthetic.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text). Treatment definition inferred from table1.do/table2.do/figure4.do/figure5.do (variables black, treated/post, black_treated; FE1 = businessid zipcode#week). Add to data/synthetic_packages.txt if not already listed.
